what: 3D miniatures for the SRD 5.2.1 Fey campaign batch (12 creatures: Violet Fungus, Giant Wasp, Satyr, Steam Mephit, Blink Dog, Sprite, Dryad, Bugbear Warrior, Harpy, Sea Hag, Green Hag, and Will-o'-Wisp).
made: 2026-11-25, for Forests and Faeries, at the maintainer's request.
design: Original, generic fantasy miniatures matching the SRD 5.2.1 stat blocks and the matte tabletop-miniature style of the existing heroes, undead, goblins, kobold warrior and animated armor. No third-party geometry, textures, armatures or animation data.
pipeline: Reference images (11 Tripo creatures): original front + matching 180-degree back turnaround views (plus 90-degree left profile for Blink Dog and Giant Wasp) generated via subscription Gemini image generation (Option A, 0.00 EUR, no paid image API) in the project's stylized tabletop-miniature palette and neutral symmetric pose.

Meshes (11 creatures): Tripo API v3 multiview-to-model, model v3.1-20260211, standard geometry, detailed PBR texture, 40 credits each, on the maintainer's Tripo API account under a code-enforced 520.0-credit batch cap (440.0 / 520.0 spent).
Will-o'-Wisp (1 creature): procedural glowing ethereal marsh-lantern orb built directly in Blender 5.2.3 LTS with procedural WebP PBR/emissive maps (0 Tripo credits).

Rigged copies (all 12): Blender 5.2.3 LTS, welded single-shell meshes decimated to ~18k triangles (8.1k for procedural Will-o'-Wisp), 1024 px WebP Color/Normal/ORM textures, normalized to face glTF -Z with feet/base grounded at y=0, bone-heat geodesic skin weights, rigid bone-parented weapon sockets where held (Bugbear_Hammer and Sprite_Needle_Sword on Weapon.R), and 9 procedural combat clips (idle, walk, run, guard, slash, arrow, cast, hit, death).
rights: Generated with the maintainer's own accounts under the terms that applied at the time; no third-party asset is included.

references.subject: Violet Fungus (SRD 5.2.1 Medium Plant, CR 1/4): ambulatory woodland mushroom creature with a wide domed mottled plum-violet cap speckled with pale lilac warts and deep indigo underside gills, a stout gnarled pale-lavender-grey fibrous stalk torso, four thick dark-violet whip-like spore tendrils hanging symmetrically downward and slightly outward from beneath the cap rim like arms (clean gap from stalk), and four sturdy splayed fibrous root-legs planted firmly on the ground with clear space between them. Generic fantasy plant creature, original design.
